phrase.zh: 压力之下，物质显出新的面貌。
phrase.en: Under pressure, matter reveals another face.

visual.zh: 上下两块厚实压块夹住中央的三层折叠薄片，细刻线表现大平面和薄层的转折，两侧留出空隙。
visual.en: Two thick blocks surround three folded layers at the center; fine hatching follows the broad planes and thin folds, with open gaps at the sides.

background.zh:
布里奇曼因发明产生极高压力的方法，以及由此在高压物理研究中取得的发现，获得1946年诺贝尔物理学奖。画面用相向的厚压块和中间压紧的折层表达压力下的材料变化，是原创寓意，不复原他的真实仪器，也不表示压力数值。短句为原创。
1946年物理学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：发明能够产生极高压力的装置，并利用它在高压物理领域作出发现。
background.en:
Bridgman received the 1946 Nobel Prize in Physics for methods producing extremely high pressures and discoveries in high-pressure physics. Opposing blocks and compacted folded layers express material response through an original metaphor, not his actual apparatus or measured pressure. The phrase is original.
1946 — The Nobel Prize in Physics. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for the invention of an apparatus to produce extremely high pressures, and for the discoveries he made therewith in the field of high pressure physics

labelLocalized.en: 1946 The Nobel Prize in Physics — official record
